segments.name: Consumer Banking
segments.description: Provides retail banking and wealth management and insurance services to individual customers.
segments.evidence: Valley's Wealth Management and Insurance Services Division, comprised of asset management advisory, brokerage, trust, personal and title insurance, tax credit advisory services, and our international and domestic private banking businesses, is a reporting unit within the Consumer Banking segment.

segments.name: Commercial Banking
segments.description: Provides lending, leasing and treasury services to small and middle market businesses across various industries.
segments.evidence: We make commercial loans to small and middle market businesses, primarily located in New Jersey, New York, and Florida.

revenueModel.text: Valley earns net interest income from interest earned on loans and investment securities, net of interest paid on deposits and borrowings, plus fee income from banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: Net interest income is the difference between interest income earned on interest-earning assets, such as loans and investment securities, and interest expense paid on interest bearing liabilities, such as deposits and borrowed funds.
